title: 第21章 雪柔姐出事了第22章 得解决祸患
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 第二天天蒙蒙亮，林夜从床上爬起来。
他现在身体素质强得可怕，前两天的疲劳休息一晚就精神抖擞龙精虎猛。
刚出里屋，就瞧见他娘常氏正在给林小满套着外套，一旁张雪柔手拎着个篮子。
林夜生了个懒腰，随口问道：“这是打算出门？”
“对，还要买点盐茶叶什么的，给你当拜师礼，家里也要添不少家伙什。”
林夜并不在意花费。
昨个他就已经说好了，之前赚的钱用来改善家里。
以后学武的开销，他自己会继续赚。
他的目光落到张雪柔身上。
“雪柔姐，你也去？”
张雪柔一对上他的目光，就连忙低下头，轻声“嗯”了一声。
小满得意地叉着腰：“昨天你不带我们，今天我们也不带你。”
林夜觉得可爱得不行，狠狠揉了揉她的脑袋。
小丫头才用新头绳扎的头发，顿时气鼓鼓地捂着脑袋。
“坏二哥，小满不给你带糖葫芦了。”
常氏拍了下他的手。
“好了，别逗你妹妹，马上牛车就要到村口了，我们还要赶紧走。
锅里有早食赶紧吃了。”
林夜嘿嘿一笑，目送着三人离开，这才去井边洗漱。
林大河正捧着根木头一点点削着。
他凑上去看了眼，见那木头呈现淡红深褐色。
搜索了一下记忆，林夜问道：
“爹，这是红榆木？”
林大河头也不抬：“从木匠那弄来的，正好适合给你做弓。
用它做弓臂，弓胎内层用红桑木，保管做出来的不比徐虎家的弓差。”
林夜心中钦佩不已。
他这个爹，能种地，会打猎，甚至还会做竹编和木工活。
爱护孩子敬重妻子，踏实勤劳，年轻时候还是个帅哥。
简直是十项全能好男人！
唯一的缺点就是过于惯着独苗儿子。
不过这对他来说却是一个什么也换不来的优点。
林夜不再打扰他，转身进了灶房。
掀开锅盖，里面还温着昨个带回来的大包子。
现在条件好了，在他的强烈要求下，家里不再省一口吃的。
估摸着现在全村只有他家一天吃三顿饭不说，还必须有一顿是荤的。

At dawn the next day, Lin Ye got up from the bed.
His physical fitness is frighteningly strong now. He was very energetic after just one night's rest after being tired from the previous two days.
As soon as he came out of the back room, he saw his mother Chang putting on Lin Xiaoman's coat, and Zhang Xuerou was holding a basket beside her.
Lin Ye got lazy and asked casually: "Are you planning to go out?"
"Yes, I also need to buy some salt, tea and other things for you as a apprenticeship ceremony. I also need to add a lot of things to the family."
Lin Ye didn't care about the cost.
He had already agreed yesterday that the money he earned before would be used to improve his home.
He will continue to earn the expenses of learning martial arts in the future.
His eyes fell on Zhang Xuerou.
"Sister Xuerou, are you going too?"
As soon as Zhang Xuerou caught his gaze, she quickly lowered her head and said softly "Yeah".
Xiaoman put his hands on his hips proudly: "You didn't take us with you yesterday, and we won't take you with you today."
Lin Ye thought she was so cute and rubbed her head hard.
The little girl, who had just tied her hair with a new hairband, suddenly covered her head with anger.
"Bad second brother, Xiaoman won't bring you candied haws."
Chang clapped his hand.
"Okay, don't tease your sister, the ox cart is coming to the village entrance soon, and we have to leave quickly.
There is breakfast in the pot and I eat it quickly. "
Lin Ye chuckled and watched the three people leave before going to the well to wash up.
Lin Dahe was holding a piece of wood and peeling it bit by bit.
He went up to take a look and saw that the wood was reddish and dark brown.
After searching his memory, Lin Ye asked:
"Dad, is this red elm?"
Lin Dahe didn't even raise his head: "I got it from the carpenter, just right for making a bow for you.
Use it to make bow arms, and the inner layer of the bow body is made of red mulberry wood. The result is no worse than Xu Hu's bow. "
Lin Ye was filled with admiration.
His father can farm, hunt, and even do bamboo weaving and carpentry.
He loves his children and respects his wife. He is down-to-earth and hard-working. He was a handsome guy when he was young.
He is simply a good man in all decathlons!
The only shortcoming is that he is too spoiled to his only son.
But this is an advantage that nothing can exchange for him.
Lin Ye stopped disturbing him and turned around and entered the kitchen.
When I opened the lid of the pot, the big buns I brought back yesterday were still warm inside.
Now that the conditions are better, at his strong request, the family no longer needs to save a bite of food.
It is estimated that his family is the only one in the village who eats three meals a day, and one of them must be meat.
